Nestled in the heart of Back Bay, 173 Newbury Street is one of the most private and extraordinary estates in Boston -- a handcrafted sanctuary where the city's historic charm is literally your backyard. Surrounded by the lush greenery of the Public Garden and the architectural grandeur of Copley Square, this property offers a unique blend of urban sophistication and natural beauty. Custom-built in 2000, this 4,842 sq ft home carries an irreplaceable provenance that announces itself at every turn. A native stone fireplace anchors the soaring vaulted great room. An ash sapling banister curves to the interior balcony above. Antique leaded glass casts dappled light across wide-plank floors. Reclaimed 18th-century doors from the historic Boston Public Library frame the entry -- details that can never be reproduced, only discovered. Five bedrooms, five full baths, and an attached private apartment with balcony provide extraordinary flexibility -- full-time living, multi-generational use, or hosting guests in total comfort. Hot tub, screened porch, sunroom, and outbuilding complete this urban retreat. Minutes to the Prudential and Hancock towers, Green Line and Orange Line access, and the vibrant boutiques of Newbury Street. Privacy without compromise. Craftsmanship without equal.

This rare opportunity in Back Bay offers a blend of timeless elegance and modern comfort, nestled amidst the historic charm of Boston's most prestigious neighborhoods. With its rich architectural heritage, generations of proud stewardship, and unrivaled urban sophistication, this distinguished estate stands as a testament to the enduring legacy of its past and the promise of the future for generations to come. Set on 67+/- park-like acres, this property offers 3 unique residences, a mature specimen tree farm, a spring-fed pond, wooded walking trails, and captivating views of the Prudential and Hancock towers, all just a stone's throw away from Newbury Street boutiques and the Boston Public Library. At the heart of the estate stands the main house; a well-preserved and substantial 6-bedroom, 5,000+ sq ft Victorian brownstone dating back to 1861, reported to be one of the oldest houses in the area. Retaining much of its original charm and detail, this historic jewel boasts ample-sized rooms for gatherings and entertaining, a renovated chef's kitchen, a formal dining room, 3 grand fireplaces, 2 primary suites, and plenty of room for guests. Enjoy sweeping views of the grounds from the porch laid with locally sourced marble or relish in the shade of 'the champion', a 250+-year-old black walnut tree standing as the oldest in the state and serving as a living testament to the estate's rich past. The exterior is a sight to behold with ornate and symbolic details that capture the attention of all who pass by.
